alternatives.reason_rejected: New migrate -> retrieval dependency for three lines.
Its type discards repo_id, so resolveIdentity would take repo_ids[0] over repo_id — equal on finalize-written files today, but a silent precedence change.

context: Implementation choices for the repo_ids fix: private declaredRepoId helper in v3-forward (no cross-layer import), finalize extends an existing store.json rather than replacing it, and the migrate cases live in a new single test file.
rationale: src/migrate imports only events/contracts/storage/migrate today; pulling in src/retrieval (or src/adapters/identity, whose readStoreDescriptor drops repo_id from its type and would silently flip precedence to repo_ids[0]) adds a layering edge for a three-line rule. Each copy names the other and the rule (repo_id, else first of repo_ids) so drift is visible at both sites.
summary: Chose a private declaredRepoId/readStoreJson helper pair inside v3-forward.ts that mirrors the exported declaredRepoId in retrieval/store-identity.ts, over importing it across layers
